DIPLOMA IN RADIOGRAPHY



Programme Overview

Radiography education offers opportunities for SPM and STPM graduates to acquire knowledge, skills, and attitudes in holistic and quality radiography practice. The Diploma in Radiography curriculum focuses on teaching and learning that enable the integration of theory into practice through experiential learning, while fostering the development of critical thinking and problem-solving skills, as well as encouraging lifelong commitment to professional development.


Duration: 3 Years (6 Semesters), Full Time (Coursework)
